tools.name: list_apis
tools.title: List the APIs
tools.description: Lists the APIs on Datacircle's sheet and the number of plans and providers for each. Pass an API's name to search_plans. It takes no arguments and gives the whole sheet in one answer, every API in the sheet's order, with no paging: each API's name (api), how many plans (plans) and providers (providers) it has, its sheet (sheetPage) and, where it has one, its best page (bestPage), which ranks its providers on our benchmark. Call it first when you don't know an API's name; when you do, call search_plans with it straight away. Free, no key, read-only.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.title: Search the API plans
tools.description: Searches Datacircle's sheet of API plans and gives the ones that match, best first unless you sort them. Call list_apis first for the APIs' names, then pass one as api for that API's plans; leave api out to search every API at once. Add query to find a provider or a plan by name, and sort by price for the cheapest first. Each plan holds every key of the sheet's JSON download: its provider, plan, billing, $ per 1,000 (perThousand), score out of 100 (score), rate limits, speed, the fields it returns and its page on datacircle.dev (page). What each key means: https://datacircle.dev/fields. With api, the answer links the API's sheet (sheetPage) and its best page (bestPage), which ranks its providers on our benchmark. total counts every plan found, and plans holds up to limit of them (10 unless you say, at most 50) from offset: page through the rest with offset. When no plan matches, you get total 0 and an empty plans list, not an error; an argument its schema doesn't allow, like an api list_apis doesn't give, is an error that says what it takes. Free, no key, read-only.

api.description: The API, its name as list_apis gives it. Every API when left out.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the provider's name and the plan's name read together, ignoring case and accents: "scrappa free" finds Scrappa's Free plans.

sort.description: score, the default: best first, as on the sheet at datacircle.dev, each API's plans together, unscored plans last. provider: A to Z. price: $ per 1,000, lowest first.

limit.description: How many plans to give, 1 to 50. 10 when left out.

offset.description: How many found plans to skip first. 0 when left out.
